parameters.content:
## Optional email intake · disabled by default
Choose an IMAP account in Support mailbox, review mailbox permissions and publish when ready. Email body and subject are untrusted. Sender identity is not verified and cannot authorize privileged actions.

Core operation uses the built-in browser portal and needs no email or chat account. No outbound mail is sent.
